text: Apparel and footwear items have a 10-day return window from the date of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and have original tags intact.
Electronics items like phones and laptops carry a 7-day replacement-only policy. Refunds are only issued if a replacement item is out of stock.
Home decor and furniture items have a 10-day return window if damaged or defective upon arrival. Pre-inspection photo proof is required.
Cash on Delivery (COD) refunds are processed via UPI or direct bank transfer within 3 to 5 business days after reverse pickup completion.
Prepaid orders paid via Credit/Debit card or UPI are refunded directly to the original payment source within 24 to 48 hours after pickup.
Standard delivery SLA across tier-1 cities is 2 to 4 business days. Regional and rural delivery SLA extends to 5 to 7 business days.
Express delivery options guarantee 24-hour SLA for eligible pincodes on prepaid orders placed before 12:00 PM.
Reverse pickup is free for non-defective returns in Apparel and Footwear categories. A service fee of Rs 50 applies for COD returns on items under Rs 500.
Reverse pickup attempt is conducted twice by courier partners. If both attempts fail, the return request automatically closes.
Beauty and personal care products are strictly non-returnable once the outer seal is broken due to hygiene standards.
Open-box delivery is mandatory for high-value Electronics. Customers must inspect physical condition before sharing OTP with delivery agent.
Gift card purchases and wallet top-ups are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash under any circumstances.
